items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I put the group, and I had Pop Foster on bass and Andy Anderson on guitar

ctx.x: Well, he used to smoke a good deal.

Well, he smoked (unintelligible), but Jack Teagarden and I would drink. Pop, he didn't drink much, Pops Faster. And Kaiser was on drums. Well, he did a little bit drinking while talking. And this guy that played the guitar, the bass guitar, well, he died too, used to -- Italian fellow, very good guitar player. And that was "Knocking the Jug" and Knuckles. [Eddie Lang]

The one side is "Knocking the Jug." That was the most outstanding, but the collector's item -- and "Muggles" was on the other side. So that's how we got "Knocking the Jug" because we done knocked -- he calls it, hey, man, let's knock our jug, and that means we're going to get a little drink.
